rationale: The failure is `connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3999` on both the initial attempt and retry, with a 0.0s duration — the test never reached the app. The only changed file is playwright.config.ts, where baseURL was hardcoded to port 3999 instead of the configured PORT, so the test runner is pointed at a port where no server is listening. This is a test-environment/infrastructure misconfiguration, not a product regression or a flaky timing issue.
recommendedAction: Revert the playwright.config.ts change so baseURL uses the configured PORT (or start the app on 3999), then re-run the suite; if the port was intentionally changed, update the webServer command/port to match.
